newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN UNDERDOGS TIROL BEAT CELTIC 2-1.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN UNDERDOGS TIROL BEAT CELTIC 2-1.

text.p: Christian Mayrleb scored twice as Austria's Tirol Innsbruck made the most of poor Celtic defending for a surprise 2-1 win in a UEFA Cup second preliminary round first leg match on Tuesday.
Christian Mayrleb put the little-fancied home team ahead at the Tivoli stadium with a 22nd minute goal that came off a solo run after he picked up a pass from Roland Kirchler.
His first attempt to score bounced off Celtic goalkeeper Jonathan Gould but his second attempt found the net.
Mayrleb made it 2-0 six minutes later for a club whose poor start in the Austrian league led to the retirement of coach Dietmar Constantini two weeks ago.
Celtic's hopes revived in the 82nd minute when Alan Stubbs scored with a direct free-kick past the Austrian wall.
"It was a very good Austrian team we faced today," said Celtic's Henrik Larsson. "But everything is open for the return match. We still have good chances of qualifying."
